slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Distance Formula: the distance between (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) is d = √((x2 − x1)2 + (y2 − y1)2).

It is the Pythagorean Theorem in disguise. Draw the horizontal and vertical legs of the right triangle with the segment as hypotenuse. The legs have lengths |x2 − x1| and |y2 − y1|, so d2 is the sum of their squares.
